## SCM Pull Request & Change Verification

### 1. Change Reference
- **Associated Issue / CR**: Fixes #
- **Target Branch**: `develop` (Feature merge) or `main` (Baseline release)
- **Primary CI Owner**: 

### 2. Summary of Modifications
Provide a concise overview of the configuration items changed in this PR.

### 3. SCM Verification Checklist
- [ ] Code adheres to project modular conventions (one agent per file).
- [ ] No regression introduced into existing baseline capabilities.
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated in `backend/tests/`.
- [ ] All tests pass locally via `pytest`.
- [ ] GitHub Actions CI workflow executed with green status.
- [ ] Peer review conducted by another team member.
